source_conclusions.claim: May ORDER78 names child09H, with D2 order3GR-S-2K09H and D4 order3GR-S-3K09H, DSW200-501/DSH1770-2400; BUSINESS205 names and photographs K09H. These directly support K09H as selectable candidate code.
May ORDER66 exact N04H/N06K/N06H columns and ORDER70 exact C08K/C08H columns explicitly list3GR-S-▲K09H under対応標準子扉デザインNo. No parent-code alias needed.

Same May ORDER uses K09N in special-range diagram90 and3GR-S-3K09N in D4glass list97, while D2glass list96 uses3GR-S-2K09H. Glass lists are technical tables, not price tables. No separate09N unit entry or manufacturer alias declaration found in inspected official files.

BUSINESS328 K09H and ORDER90 K09N diagrams show matching visible composition and stated DSW200-501/DSH1770-2400 plus the same218mm/9mm daylight-position note. Raster bytes differ. Similar drawing/dimensions alone do not prove manufacturer identity or interchangeability.

November BUSINESS split files keep K09H at relevant photograph/matrix/technical entries. October ORDER72 keeps09H and both D2/D4 H unit codes; technicalglass80usesD2H and81stillusesD4N. Newer documents do not provide an explicit alias/correction statement. No full baseline switch made.

ORDER78 listsC08H among K01N compatible main doors; that compatibility does not itself establish a grey(●) recommended alternative. Candidate C08H uses direct standardH only; K01N remains available among native full candidates.

remaining_documentary_uncertainty.why_ui_standard_pending_can_end: K09H is independently and directly defined in unit/standard-child entries; candidate can select that supported code while refusing to auto-map legacyN. The source-document inconsistency itself remains recorded, not declared resolved.
